title: add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts; docs site updates
author: Priya Kumar
description: Add first-class RAG agent templates, a set of tool-calling quickstarts, and supporting docs site updates. Motivation: provide customers with production-ready examples for combining retrieval and tool calling (search, SQL, calendar), reduce onboarding friction for agents, and standardize template inputs/outputs for evals. Changes include: (1) new redwood-examples/rag-agents/ directory with three quickstarts (faq-bot, sql-assistant, calendar-helper) that demonstrate template-driven RAG flows and tool integration; (2) agent templates in redwood/agents/templates with structured schemas and validation helpers; (3) docs site updates to add a dedicated "RAG & Agents" section, navigation entries, and quickstart guides; (4) updated SDK examples for Python and TypeScript to show tool registration and streaming responses. Checklist: - [x] add example code and README for each quickstart; - [x] add agent templates and validation helpers; - [x] update docs website pages and sidebars; - [x] run unit and integration tests for examples; - [x] confirm examples work against hosted and local runtimes. Related Linear: ENG-4521 (rag quickstarts), ENG-4602 (agents: tool-calling examples). Notes: examples avoid large data bundles and instead use a small in-repo dataset and a mocked search connector to keep CI cheap; docs include screenshots and a short demo GIF.
